prompt: Create one TOP view, a literal vertical overhead orthographic plan. The first reference is an independently approved TOP plan diagram of a bench: copy its shallow long footprint and seating-plan arrangement only. The second reference is the exact Iron Trains source+six sheet: copy its dark iron and worn reddish-brown wood identity only. The finished object is a bench: long axis left-right, shallow depth top-bottom. Show three seat slats as the horizontal seating surface, and the backrest only as a very thin raised rail/edge along the rear long side. From above, NEVER show a broad upright backrest panel. Maintain iron frame/legs as narrow end footprints and the correct bench footprint. No red upholstery, no yellow trim, no tall wood wall, no perspective. Transparent canvas, centered with margin, inferred orthographic view.

reference_inputs.role: approved top-down geometry guide only; do not copy red fabric or yellow rails
target source and material identity only

rejection_reason: candidate remains a broad multi-board panel rather than the required seat surface and thin backrest edge
